name: Menàrguens (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and green, the yellow stripe with two black teeth on its upper edge.
history: The flag of the town of Menàrguens is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, tierced horizontally green, yellow and green, the central stripe with two black teeth on its upper edge; the arms were approved on 15 November 1991 and the flag was published in the DOGC on 21 April 1993.

features.role: two triangular teeth on the upper edge of the yellow stripe
